faqs.a:
Arvada may deny an application if, based on the information provided in the application,
               at the public hearing and/or any terms of a proposed franchise agreement:
(1)
The applicant does not have the financial, technical, or legal qualifications to provide
                  cable service;
(2)
The applicant will not provide adequate public, educational, and governmental access
                  channel capacity, facilities, or financial support; or
(3)
The applicant's proposed terms do not comply with applicable federal, state and local
                  laws and regulations including, but not limited to, local customer service standards,
                  or relevant existing contractual obligations of Arvada.
(
Ord. No. 4078, § 1, 7-16-07
)
